items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Dan Morgenstern has got the tapes.

ctx.x: Didn't I tell you he played my guitar? -- At Morton's, everybody used to meet at Morton's -- Monk, Joe Guy, Kenny Clarke, his brother -- a lot of people don't know his brother played bass. Charlie Christian was there all the time. I'm just learnin' how to play. So I come in and Charlie has taken my guitar

And played it, played the hell out of it, 4 strings -- he played it. And that made me wanna play that much worse, ha, ha. He was a nice cat. He was tickled at me for the 4 strings. He said, "man why don't you get yourself six strings". I say, "I can hardly play these four, no sense of six." He played it all right, old Gibson I had. But he could play, I got some tapes around here. Dan Morgenstern has got the tapes. He's got the records --
Q. Cats and the Fiddle record dates, Songs composed by TG
